wiki.title: Zandro Rageracer
wiki.text:
Zandro Rageracer is a dwarf NPC boss featured as the main antagonist of the Sunstone Valley questline. He is the leader of the Skullz that made his first appearance in the Skullz Base Camp when the player and the Freewheelers come to confront him. He obtained super-human features while being influenced by the mysterious magic known as the Gloam. With the Gloam abilities, he led a Skullz invasion of Sunstone Valley.

Biography
Before the events of the Freewheelers vs. Skullz, Zandro was once a normal person where he were grumpy and lonely, many the Freewheelers are enjoyed with each other and has feast in Wheelie Pete's. Zandro was the only one who started the Skullz. He challenged with Gus in a race, later Gus won in a race against Zandro. Zandro then met the stranger who is a part of the Gloam, he still don't know who she was. Zandro was influenced and obtained the Gloam abilities, then he use the power to convince the Dwarves to join the Skullz, and the gang had risen to power over Sunstone Valley.
